comments.author: ytjohn
comments.why: Gource visualization of Minecraft's development history.
comments.text: For those that like things like this, check out [LINK] - it's desktop only, but produces awesome visualizations. It works by going through your git history and essentially shows programmers buzzing around the code and updating files. It can do generic avatars, or even download their gravatar if they have one. A lot of videos online, but two great ones are: * The History of Python [VIDEO] * 800+ days of Minecraft in 8 minutes [VIDEO]
